items.title: Can Hershey step up to buy Mondelez?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Hershey and Mondelez are more likely to expand partnerships in international markets than pursue a full-scale merger in the near term, Bernstein said, pointing to the success of their recent Reese’s and Oreo product collaborations.
